# Townsville Pool Builders

Townsville Pool Builders (https://townsvillepoolbuilders.com.au/) is a free referral and quote service for people who want a swimming pool built in Townsville, Queensland, Australia. It is not a pool construction company and does not design, excavate or build pools. Enquiries submitted through the quote form are passed to one local pool builder who services the customer's area. The builder contacts the customer directly.

Target search phrases: pool builders townsville; swimming pool builders townsville; inground pools townsville.

## Important facts
- No phone number is published on the site.
- The site does not publish its own pool prices, reviews, or “number 1” claims.
- Pool cost figures that appear on the cost guide are cited from named public industry guides, with links.
- Queensland pool fencing and approval information is summarised from QBCC, Queensland Government and Townsville City Council, QLD pages, with links to those sources.
- Contact for enquiries and privacy requests: quotes@townsvillepoolbuilders.com.au.
